rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet is cited for the rule that the best deed is the most sustained, even when small, supporting regular prayer.
rows.anchor: كما روي عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: "أفضلُ العملِ أدومُه وإنْ قَلَّ"

rows.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
rows.claim: Al-Kashshaf distinguishes دوام as steadily performing the prayers without omitting them or becoming occupied by distractions.
rows.anchor: وقد فرق صاحب (الكشاف) بين الدوام والمحافظة على الصلاة

rows.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
rows.claim: Al-Kashshaf explains المحافظة as perfecting ablution, observing prayer times, pillars, sunnas and manners, and guarding prayer from sins that undo it.
rows.anchor: وقد فرق صاحب (الكشاف) بين الدوام والمحافظة على الصلاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hell calls those who turned from obedience and truth, while the constant worshippers turn toward obedience and are thereby saved from its punishment.
rows.anchor: فإن ذلك الذي تدعوه جهنم، قد أدبر عن الطاعة وتولى عن الحق، وهذا مقبل على الطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The paired wording أدبر وتولى reinforces turning away, then answers it with إلا المصلين and the worshippers who remain constant in prayer.
rows.anchor: وقال: (وتولى) وهو توكيد للإدبار والانصراف عن الطاعة

words: اركعوا واسجدوا واعبدوا ربكم وافعلوا الخير
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The commands to bow, prostrate, worship, do good, establish prayer and give zakat match the opening of al-Muʾminun and its listed believer qualities.
rows.anchor: فأنت ترى من الأمر بالركوع والسجود وعبادة الله، وفعل الخير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Hajj makes success a hoped-for result of the commands, whereas al-Muʾminun declares that success has occurred after the believers obeyed.
rows.anchor: فقد أمرهم بالركوع والسجود، ليرجى لهم الفلاح، وهنا تحقق الفلاح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verbal form in the address describes becoming believers, while the nominal المؤمنون presents their response as a settled quality.
rows.anchor: فناداهم بالصيغة الفعلية الدالة على الحدوث، فاستجابوا واتصفوا بذلك على وجه الثبات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Imperative acts such as bowing, prostration, prayer and zakat become stable believer traits, expressed through nominal descriptions of humility, turning from idle talk and giving zakat.
rows.anchor: فاتصفوا بما أمرهم به ربهم على وجه الثبات، فوصفهم بالصيغة الاسمية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Tur names several accusations, including soothsayer, madman, poet and fabricator; al-Qalam mentions only madness, so the extra denial of soothsaying suits al-Tur.
rows.anchor: فقد ذكروا أنه كاهن، وذكروا أنه مجنون، وذكروا أنه شاعر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Tur's claim that listeners should bring clear authority from their hearing evokes the jinn-listening claimed by soothsayers, making the added word كاهن apt.
rows.anchor: والاستماع مما تدعيه الكهنة لتابعيهم من الجن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because al-Tur also challenges the audience over magic, denying that the Prophet is a soothsayer fits that surah's subject matter.
rows.anchor: فناسب ذكر السحر ذكر الكهنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Tur opens with a much longer oath than al-Qalam, whose oath is only by the pen and what is written; this broader setting suits the added accusation.
rows.anchor: توسع في القسم في أول سورة الطور بخلاف سورة القلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The extended opening oath in al-Tur makes its added denial of soothsaying fitting, unlike al-Qalam's brief oath by the pen and writing.
rows.anchor: فناسب التوسع في الطور هذه الزيادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Qalam ends by reporting the unbelievers' charge that the Prophet is mad, and its opening answers that same charge with a denial.
rows.anchor: فرد عليهم في أول السورة بنفي الجنون عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The emphatic bāʾ strengthens the negation of madness at the opening, matching the emphatic lām in the closing affirmation that they call him mad.
rows.anchor: كيف ناسب التأكيد بالباء الزائدة في النفي (بمجنون) التوكيد باللام في الإثبات (لمجنون)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The surah centers on the Day of Judgment and closes with it, so it singles out belief in that day among the pillars of faith.
rows.anchor: فجو السورة والسياق في الكلام على يوم الدين، وختم السورة بالكلام عليه

words: والذين هم من عذاب ربهم مشفقون
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear of the Lord's punishment fits a surah saturated with punishment, from its opening threat through its final scene of humiliation.
rows.anchor: وذكر الإشفاق من العذاب مناسب لجو السورة أيضاً، فإن السورة مشحونة بذكر العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who affirm Judgment and fear punishment are exempt from the traits of haluʿ: faith brings reassurance, patience under harm for God's reward, and generosity because God will repay good many times over.
rows.anchor: التصديق بيوم الدين مدعاة للطمأنينة والأمن في النفوس، فهو يصبر إذا مسه الشر احتسابا لأجر ذلك عند الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: جمع فأوعى means collecting wealth, putting it into a container or hoarding it, and withholding God's required due from its recipients.
rows.anchor: ومعنى جمع فأوعى: أنه جمع المال بعضه على بعض فأوعاه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people who set aside a defined share for the asker and deprived are the opposite of those summoned by Hell for turning away and hoarding wealth.
rows.anchor: فقد جعلوا في أموالهم حقا معلوما للسائل والمحروم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When prosperity and wealth reach the person described as منوعا, he is miserly and withholds God's due from it.
rows.anchor: إذا أصابه الخير والمال والغنى بخل ومنع حق الله تعالى فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Giving to the poor cures both sides of haluʿ: the donor does not grieve as if afflicted when wealth leaves, and does not deny the needy their share.
rows.anchor: فإخراج المال إلى الفقراء والمساكين علاج وشفاء لهذا الداء الوبيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One meaning of الشوى is human skin; Hell strips the skin and leaves the entrails exposed.
rows.anchor: ومن معاني (الشوى) جلد الإنسان فهي، أي: جهنم تنزعُ جلدَ الإنسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Skin protects the entrails as a container protects wealth; the hoarder who enclosed his money has his body's enclosing skin torn away and its contents exposed.
rows.anchor: والجلد للأحشاء كالوعاء للمال يحفظ ما في داخله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The saying انج بجلدك marks skin as more precious to a person than wealth, making the punishment a fitting recompense of the same kind as the hoarding sin.
rows.anchor: فانظر التناسق الجميل بين المعصية والعذاب، والجزاء من جنس العمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Belief in Judgment is highlighted because the surah's atmosphere concerns that day, described as the angels' ascent in a day of fifty thousand years and as near despite unbelievers' denial.
rows.anchor: وهذا اليوم هو يوم القيامة، كما جاء في الحديث الصحيح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The saved group affirms the Day of Judgment, which unbelievers regard as distant and impossible.
rows.anchor: الكفار يستبعدون وقوعه ويرونه محالا، في حين أن هؤلاء المعافين يصدقون به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مرء suits the flight scene better than رجل because it can include young and old, humans and jinn, while رجل covers adult males; it also denotes a human or a man.
rows.anchor: فانظر كيف اختار أوفق كلمة وأنسبها لهذا المقام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Resurrection flight scene belongs in Abasa, which opens with turning away: turning aside is a kind of flight, frowning is inward flight from something, and being distracted from the seeker is another form of it.
rows.anchor: والتولي نوع من أنواع الفرار من الشيء والانصراف عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The greater punishment scene belongs in al-Maʿarij, which opens with punishment; thus the surah beginning with punishment contains punishment, and the one beginning with turning away contains flight.
rows.anchor: فوضع مشهد العذاب في السورة التي تبدأ بالعذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مرء normally denotes a man, its feminine is امرأة, and its plural رجال is formed from another word; it can also mean a human being.
rows.anchor: ذلك أن الأصل في كلمة (المرء) أن تطلق على الرجل، وقد تُؤنَّثُ هذه الكلمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مرء is more fitting than إنسان because the scene includes fleeing from one's wife and children, and the fleeing spouse is a man whereas إنسان includes men and women.
rows.anchor: فاختيار (المرء) ههنا أوفق من (الإنسان) ذلك أنه ذكر الفرار من الصاحبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مرء is narrower than إنسان when it means a male, but broader when it can include jinn; the flight scene encompasses men of both jinn and humans.
rows.anchor: فكلمة (مرء) أعمُّ من كلمة (إنسان) من ناحية وأخصُّ منها من ناحية أخرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In المؤمنون 23:4, الزكاة can mean the amount of wealth paid to its rightful recipient.
rows.anchor: فإن (الزكاة) اسم مشترك بين عدة معانٍ، فقد يطلق على القَدْر الذي يخرجه المزكّي من ماله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الزكاة can also be the verbal noun تزكية: the act of paying the prescribed amount from one's wealth to its recipient.
rows.anchor: وقد يطلق على المصدر بمعنى: التزكية، وهو الحدث، والمعنى: إخراج القدْر المفروض من الأموال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الزكاة can mean righteous action and purification of the self from idolatry and defilement, as the cited verses use it for purity and purification.
rows.anchor: وقد تكون بمعنى العمل الصالح، وتطهير النفس من الشرك والدنس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The financial, verbal, righteous-action and purification senses can all be intended together in this compact expression.
rows.anchor: وهذه المعاني مجتمعة يصح أن تكون مرادة في هذا التعبير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse can mean that believers pay zakat by construing فاعلون as مؤدون or estimating a deleted noun, لأداء الزكاة.
rows.anchor: وذلك على تضمين (فاعلون) معنى (مؤدّون) أو على تقدير مضاف محذوف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On another parse, الزكاة is the object of فاعلون, fronted for exclusivity; the lām reinforces the relation and is called لام التقوية, as in 2:91.
rows.anchor: فالزكاة مفعولٌ به لاسم الفاعل (فاعلون) ، ثم قدم المفعول للاختصاص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With either grammatical analysis, الزكاة denotes the concrete wealth paid to its rightful recipient.
rows.anchor: وبهذين التقديرين يكون المقصود بالزكاة اسم العين، وهو المال الذي يخرج لمستحقه

rows.speaker: أبو مسلم
rows.claim: Abu Muslim reads الزكاة here as righteous work, as in the cited description خيراً منه زكاة; al-Bahr also reports this view.
rows.anchor: وعن أبي مسلم أن الزكاة هنا بمعنى العمل الصالح كما في قوله تعالى: {خَيْراً مِّنْهُ زَكَاةً}

rows.speaker: الراغب
rows.claim: Al-Raghib takes الزكاة to mean purity and the lām as causal: they worship so God purifies them or they purify themselves.
rows.anchor: واختار الراغب أن الزكاة بمعنى الطهارة، واللام للتعليل

rows.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
rows.claim: Al-Kashshaf says they do good for the sake of purity and self-purification, supported by the verses about purification and prayer.
rows.anchor: قال صاحب "الكشاف"، معنى الآية، الذين هم لأجل الطهارة وتزكية النفس عاملون الخير

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view in al-Bahr reads الزكاة as growth and increase, with a causal lām and an omitted object: doing good to attain growth.
rows.anchor: وقيل: الزكاة هنا: النماء والزيادة. واللام لام العلة ومعمول فاعلون محذوف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse can intend financial zakat, righteous work, purification and growth together; its lām can strengthen the construction or express purpose.
rows.anchor: فالزكاة إذن تحتمل العبادة المالية، وتحتمل العمل الصالح والتطهير والنماء، واللام تحتمل التقوية، وتحتمل التعليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Replacing فاعلون with مؤتون would restrict the meaning to financial zakat, while removing the lām would lose the purpose sense; no other wording gathers all the meanings so simply.
rows.anchor: فلو أبدل كلمة (مؤتون) مكان (فاعلون) لاقتصر الأمر على زكاة المال، ولو حذف اللام لم يفد معنى التعليل

rows.speaker: ابن كثير
rows.claim: Ibn Kathir reports that most interpreters take this as financial zakat despite the verse being Meccan; the zakat instituted in Medina in year two appears to be the threshold-based obligation.
rows.anchor: جاء في (تفسير ابن كثير) : "الأكثرون على أن المراد بالزكاة ههنا زكاة الأموال
